name: Lemon-Roasted Tofu with Dill Yogurt Sauce & Greek Salad

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
½ small bunch fresh dill
1 pint grape tomatoes
1 English cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Juice half of the lemon into a small baking dish. Add oil, vinegar, sugar, and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade. (Reserve remaining lemon for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
balsamic vinegar
1 tsp brown sugar
garlic powder
oregano, dried
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu planks in half crosswise. Add to the baking dish with the marinade and turn to coat.
Place tofu in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, turning once, until golden brown and warmed through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between a small and a medium bowl, then set the medium bowl aside for the salad.
Juice reserved lemon into the small bowl with the dill. Add yogurt, mayo, and spices, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp mayonnaise
oregano, dried
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add oil, vinegar, and spices to the medium bowl with the dill, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
balsamic vinegar
garlic powder
oregano, dried
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and tofu between plates or bowls. Top tofu with sauce and enjoy!
